PM Modi Speech : pradhanmantri narendr modi ne vaishali men aayojit janasbha men bihar ke vikas aur kendr sarkar ki yojnaon ka jikr kiya... piem modi ne kaha ki ek samay bihar ke hajaron ganvon tak bijli nahin pahunchi thi, lekin aaj bihar bijli utpadan ka bara kendr banta ja raha hai...pradhanmantri ne shahri yatayat ko behtar banane ke lie 100 aadhunik piem ee-bason ko hari jhandi dikhaee... iske sath hi pradhanmantri aavas yojna ke tahat hajaron garib parivaron ko unke pakke gharon ki chabiyan saunpi gaeen
